pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored pathways with uniform pixel thickness; junction nodes consist primarily of tri-radial intersections, maintaining high topological connectivity across the visible flank.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A faint, light-colored linear mark is visible traversing the mid-upper flank across multiple dark patches, indicative of a superficial scar or abrasion.
